notes: NEC runs two calendars: a conference planning calendar (Google Calendar, departmental and administrative) and an events board that also carries local-church and youth-federation events. Local-church items are kept with level='church' so the comparison can include or exclude them.

The conference calendar plugin only shows the last 3 months; Oct 2025-Jun 2026 conference-calendar items are therefore not available, and that period relies on the events board and news, so meetings (EXCOM, pastors' meetings, ACS monthly meetings) are under-counted before July 2026.
Funeral and memorial services, a benefit concert for an individual, and personal names were excluded/removed. A church-based 'legacy foundation' named after a person is shown without the name.
Volleyball and basketball league game nights (weekly) are grouped as recurring items.

Notable actual activity: conference-wide evangelistic campaigns 11 Jul-1 Aug 2026 plus a 'Youth & Young Adult Evangelism Month' (Aug 2026); Haitian Ministries evangelistic meetings in Rochester, NY (28 Aug-19 Sep 2026); Hispanic ministry evangelism (12-20 Sep 2026); Daniel & Revelation seminar for Portuguese churches (Oct 2026); 58th Personal Ministries & Federation Convention (28-30 Aug 2026); Elevate Leadership Summit (~1,000 registrants, Feb 2026); strong ACS/community-service rhythm (monthly ACS meetings, back-to-school giveaway for ~900 children, toy and Thanksgiving giveaways, Caribbean hurricane-relief mission); health emphases (Health Sabbath, Health Convocation, virtual 5K, mental-health presentations).

Language-group structure is visible in the calendar: English, Franco-Haitian (Congres Laic, Haitian camp meeting and lay convention), Hispanic 'NEN/NES/NY/WNY' regions (camp meeting, officer trainings, women's and men's retreats), Portuguese.

Women's Ministries Retreat 2025 'Thrive' was held in Jamaica in October 2025 (news byline: October 2025; exact dates not stated) - not recorded as an event because the date is not given. Consecration service for newly elected leaders (news, 6 Nov 2025) also undated.
Constituency (29th Regular / Sixth Quadrennial Session) was 28 Sep 2025, just before the window.
